Most of the course was not that interesting. These parts I could learn by simply reading a book. The most interesting part was language and compiler design. However, we did not go all the way with the compiler design. Also, I felt that language design project was evaluated more based on the quality of the reports than the quality of the languages created. I feel that creativity and complexity I tried to put into the language of my project was wasted and it would be much better grade-wise had I created a very simple language. Finally, I think the assignments both homework and project wise were not clear. There were requirements that were not put into the requirements part of the assignment that you had to deduce from vague statements. I think the syllabus of this course needs an overhaul to focus more on the interesting subjects.
